text:
aj: Quick heads-up, p99 latency jump on Llama2-13B in dedicated-south after yesterday's auto-kernel selector tweak. p95 up ~40%, p99 doubled. Root appears when chat template >= 512 tokens.

maria: repro?

aj: repro steps and quick logs:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"llama2-13b","input":"<long chat template>","max_tokens":256}'
```
Profiler snippet pasted here:
```
- kernel: fastpath_opt (selected)
- avg kernel time: 6.2ms -> 9.8ms (p99)
- kv-alloc churn observed during prefix handling (many small memcpy/copies)
```

ken: I saw something similar on Mixtral last month. Could be head-alignment + RoPE theta mismatch forcing extra transposes and copy paths. Any flamegraphs?

sophia: uploaded flamegraph: https://perf-s3.redwood/reports/3605/ll2-13b-fastpath.html - shows hot memcpy in KV copy + a small loop in selector fallback.

aj: quick hypothesis: selector now prefers fastpath for hidden_size=4096 head_dim=64 combos, but our RoPE defaults for longer chat templates interact badly (stride/scale) and trigger a slow codepath in the runtime that copies KV more aggressively.

ranjit: can we force selector to prefer legacy kernel for that exact model_id as a temporary mitigation? cheap and low-risk.

aj: yep, I toggled selector flag on a canary and re-ran the same workload: p99 returned to baseline. Minimal guard added locally: if seq_len > 256 and head_dim == 64 then prefer legacy_kernel.

maria: we should make this detectable in CI. Add a smoke perf job that runs synthetic chat templates at seq_len 512/1024 for 13B models and asserts p99 <= baseline*1.2.

sophia: will add perf test and instrument kv_alloc_count metric so we can alert on regressions in allocations/copies.

ken: follow-ups: enumerate model configs that hit the pattern (head_dim multiples, hidden_size combos), include quantized variants (q4/q8) since selector heuristics differ.

infra-bot: @aj deployed canary to dedicated-south-1 (canary id c-3605-1)

aj: thanks. Action items: (1) sophia - add CI perf test + kv metric, (2) ranjit - PR with selector guard and unit tests, (3) ken - run model matrix to enumerate affected model ids and quantized variants, (4) maria - observe canary and rollback if p99 > threshold. Will triage in tomorrow eng-runtime sync.

maria: :thumbsup:
